findings.finding: The move of `_update_one_dispatch_links` to dispatch_update.py breaks the CI-enforced complexity-baseline gate, an unenumerated consumer outside the artifact's directory. .github/complexity-baseline.json:30 records a ceiling keyed `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_one.py::_update_one_dispatch_links` (value 17, above the 15 C901 threshold). scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py keys each finding by `<path>::<qualified-symbol>` and fails closed when `new>0`; after the move the finding appears at `dispatch_update.py::_update_one_dispatch_links` with no matching baseline entry (a NEW finding), while the old entry becomes stale. The plan's Scope/Testing/Acceptance sections never mention updating this baseline.
findings.suggested_fix: In Scope add `.github/complexity-baseline.json` — the `_update_one_dispatch_links` C901 ceiling entry re-pointed from the dispatch_one.py path to the dispatch_update.py path; add an Acceptance Criterion that `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` reports `new=0`.

findings.finding: The moving symbol `_update_one_dispatch_links` (defined at `dispatch_one.py:702`, inside the 432-796 sub-tree the plan relocates to `dispatch_update.py`) is a keyed entry in `.github/complexity-baseline.json:30` as `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_one.py::_update_one_dispatch_links`. The complexity gate keys ceilings by `<file-path>::<qualified-symbol>`; moving the function changes its path component, so the C901 census will emit `dispatch_update.py::_update_one_dispatch_links`, which `compare()` classifies as a NEW entry (regression → check fails) and `lock_against_base` flags as needing an admin override. The plan's Scope inventory omits `.github/complexity-baseline.json`.
findings.location: Scope section (four-file list) and 'Extract the entire update_one sub-tree — lines 432-796'
findings.suggested_fix: Run the C901 baseline updater after the move (or manually rename the key at .github/complexity-baseline.json:30 from `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_one.py::_update_one_dispatch_links` to `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_update.py::_update_one_dispatch_links`, preserving the ceiling value 17 and sorted ordering), and add the file to Scope and an acceptance criterion.
